title: These two brothers built a $1.1 billion company from their childhood bedrooms, without a dollar from VCs.
caption:
These two brothers built a $1.1 billion company from their childhood bedrooms, without a dollar from VCs.

They put their life savings into a free homework app. Revenue fell to almost zero.

Then a hackathon flipped it. Now companies like Google and Ripple pay EasyA upfront to teach developers their tech.

When crypto crashed, it became their best growth year. They've confidentially filed to go public.

Could you build that without VC money?
